The Town of Rindge is an SB2 or official ballot referendum town. This means there are two sessions of the annual town meeting: 
The Deliberative Session:  Takes place between the first and second Saturdays following the last Monday in January, including those Saturdays (NH RSA 40:13 III). It is typically scheduled for the first Saturday of February at Rindge Memorial School, starting at 9:00 am. Please check the calendar to confirm. During this session, an explanation of the warrant and budget is given by the Board of Selectmen, the Budget Advisory Committee, and Department Heads. Each warrant article is opened to the registered voters in attendance to discuss, debate, and amend as allowed by state law. See NH RSA 40:13 IV. This session is run by the Town Moderator. 
The Voting Session:  It always takes place on the second Tuesday of March from 7:00 am to 7:00 pm at the Rindge Memorial School. This session is held jointly with the Jaffrey-Rindge School District Voting Session. This is an official ballot session and runs similarly to a state or general election. 
 Declaration of Candidacy 
Residents of Rindge can file for candidacy for any of the open positions or elected officials in the Town of Rindge. The available positions and candidacy form can be found in the documents below under the current election year or linked below this paragraph. The filing period starts on the 7th Wednesday before the Town Election and ends on the Friday of the following week, per NH RSA 669:19. The exact dates will be posted annually. You can file with the town clerk's office during normal business hours and on the last Friday in person only during the posted hours.  
Please note that any form submitted on the last day of the filing period must be submitted in person by the candidate, but that prior to the last day the completed form can be mailed or delivered to the clerk provided it is received prior to the last day of the filing period.  All forms must be submitted with a "wet" signature.
